name: Bradley Tusk
details: Building VoteSecure, an open-source mobile voting platform. Legislation advancing in CO, MD, MN, NJ, VT, and NYC. Seeking election officials and legislators to pilot and expand mobile voting access.

name: Civic Match
details: Talent matching platform connecting mission-driven professionals with state and local govt roles. Free to job seekers and hiring managers. Also recruiting for a new Responsive Cities Network fellowship. Rolling.

name: FAS Impact Fellowship
details: Rolling placements of scientists and technologists in federal and state agencies. New roles posted quarterly. Current opening: AI/ML Engineering Director at a state government. Check site for latest listings.

name: AI Government Leadership Program
details: Free 6-session program training senior govt leaders (GS-15, SES, state/local executives) on AI strategy. No technical knowledge required. Fall 2026 cohort, orientation August 27. Supported by Microsoft and Google.org.

name: Code for America AI Government Partnership
details: Partnering with state and local agencies to design and deploy AI for benefits access and service delivery. SNAP Policy Navigator now live. Reach out to explore what a partnership could look like.

name: Free AI Training for Government
details: Free weekly live workshops and self-paced courses on responsible AI for public sector employees. Spring 2026 series active now. 40K+ learners across 100+ agencies. Any govt agency can access or formally partner at no cost.

name: Voting Information Project (VIP)
details: Free tool for election officials to share official voting location and ballot data with millions of voters through Google Civic API and major platforms. 40+ state and DC partners. No cost to participate.

name: American Connection Corps
details: AmeriCorps service fellowship placing fellows in local govts and nonprofits focused on digital access, community resilience, and economic opportunity. Open for 2026-2027 program year.

name: Congressional Innovation Fellowship
details: Up to 20 early- and mid-career technologists placed in Congressional offices Jan 2027. Domains: govt innovation, climate, science. Stipend $73.5K-$96.75K. Deadline June 25.

name: Cornell Tech Urban Innovation Fellowship
details: Two-year fellowship placing technologists in New York City government agencies to work on real city technology challenges. Bloomberg Philanthropies funded. For technologists seeking public sector impact.

name: Executive Fellowship
details: Experienced professionals (15+ yrs) placed in 1-year paid roles ($80K) in city and county agencies. Two cohorts/year; rolling applications. Covers social impact, environment, and civic innovation areas.

name: Government Innovation Fellowship
details: Paid 1-year embedded fellowship ($92K) placing graduate-level professionals in state and local agencies to lead performance improvement projects. Areas: housing, justice reform, child welfare, unemployment insurance. Rolling applications.

name: AI Fluency & Capacity Building Grants
details: Rolling grants to nonprofits and public institutions building AI literacy and responsible deployment capacity. Applications accepted through July 1, 2026.

name: AI Readiness Project State Pilot
details: Seeking 10+ state, territory, and Tribal Nation partners in 2026 to run structured low-risk AI pilots. Includes cross-state working groups, shared frameworks, and a Government AI Knowledge Hub. Co-led with Center for Civic Futures.

name: Barr Fellowship
details: 15-month fellowship for senior civic sector leaders in greater Boston. $75K grant to fellows organization. ~16 days of programming. For established nonprofit and civic leaders. Deadline June 30.

name: Bloomberg Harvard City Hall Fellows
details: Annual fellowship placing emerging leaders in city halls to work on data, innovation, and performance management. Recent graduate and mid-career tracks. Bloomberg Philanthropies funded. Harvard Kennedy School partner.

name: Bloomberg Harvard City Leadership Initiative
details: Executive education for mayors and senior city officials at Harvard Kennedy School. Covers leadership, management, and urban innovation. Annual cohort. Bloomberg Philanthropies funded with Harvard Kennedy School.

name: Agency Modernization Proposals
details: Federal agencies apply for milestone-based IT modernization financing. Awards unlock as project phases complete; agencies repay from savings generated. Technical assistance provided. Rolling submission windows through Sept 30, 2026.

name: AI Upskill Accelerator Pilot Program
details: $25M federal competition for industry-led AI workforce training. 5-8 awards, $1M-$8M each, 24-36 months. Requires 1:1 match. Eligible: employers, training providers, workforce boards, universities.

name: Bobby Zipp
details: I work for a prosecutor's office as the Chief Data Officer - I oversee all data analytics initiatives across the office, and improving our data analytics capabilities often requires modernizing our operations in partnership with other parts of my office.

name: Ideas for Impact RFEI
organization: New York City Economic Development Corporation
details: Rolling open call for public-private innovation partnerships across NYC strategic priorities. Responses reviewed monthly. Open to companies, nonprofits, and research orgs. Submissions accepted through June 30.

name: OPM Data Science Fellows
details: Cross-agency fellowship placing data scientists in 2-year tours at federal agencies. Addresses critical data science skills gaps. Covers AI/ML, data engineering, and analytics. OPM talent modernization suite. Rolling.

name: OPM Project Management Fellows
details: Cross-agency fellowship placing project managers in 2-year tours at federal agencies. Addresses longstanding PM capacity gaps across government. OPM talent modernization suite alongside Data Science Fellows. Rolling.

name: TechAccess: AI-Ready America
details: $224M program for State/Territory AI Coordination Hubs. Up to $1M/year x 3 years. LOI due June 16, full proposal July 16. For universities, workforce boards, extension services. Round 1 of 3.

name: US Tech Force
details: Federal hiring initiative placing ~1,000 technologists in 2-year govt roles. $150-200K salary. Focus: AI, cybersecurity, data, software engineering. First full cohort September 2026. Rolling applications.

name: CITP Technology Fellows
organization: Center for Information Technology Policy (CITP, Princeton)
details: Non-resident fellowship for experienced government technologists engaging Princeton CITP on AI governance, data privacy, and cybersecurity policy challenges. Practitioners keep current roles. State and local focus.

name: Election Cybersecurity Initiative
details: Free expert briefings, threat evaluations, and cybersecurity tools for state and local election administrators. Led by former CISA election security director. Filling the gap as federal support contracts.

name: Georgetown Beeck Center Innovation Fellowship
details: 12-24 month fellowship for senior practitioners in digital government, data, design, and technology. Fellows publish research and build practitioner resources. Rolling applications. Georgetown Beeck Center.

name: Stanford RegLab Government Partnership
details: Partners with government agencies on data science and AI demonstration projects. Past partners: IRS, EPA, DOL, Santa Clara County, Seattle. Reach out to explore a partnership on AI, ML, or causal inference for policy.

name: State & Local Innovation Evaluation Incubator
details: State and local governments apply for technical assistance and researcher connections to design randomized evaluations. J-PAL staff guide design; affiliated researchers conduct studies. Covers housing, criminal justice, workforce, education, health.

name: CiviForm Government Deployment
details: Free open-source platform that lets residents apply for multiple government assistance programs in one place. No licensing fee. Governments self-host and control all data. Built and maintained collaboratively with government users. Rolling access.

name: Jeremie Ponak
details: Building open AI benchmarks for government - evaluating model accuracy on benefits eligibility, service delivery, and healthcare policy. Starting with SNAP. Seeking researchers and civic technologists working on AI evaluation for public sector.

name: Mirilla Zhu
organization: Legislative Information Access in Prisons and Jails
details: I'm building a version of Open States to make legislative information accessible in prisons and jails in real-time. Would love to connect with beta testers and people in government/DOC who might have interest and authority to make this resource available in facilities!

name: Pro-Bono Tech Volunteer Network
details: 11,000+ vetted pro-bono technologists (engineers, designers, PMs, researchers) available to partner with government agencies at no cost. Govts can submit requests for help. Focus: AI, procurement, benefits, elections, language access.

name: Tal Roded
details: Data scientist building open civic tech tools for NYC government: State Capacity Ecosystem Hub, NYC Government Bodies Explorer, Fiscal Impact Statement tracker. Seeking collaborators on government data infrastructure, urban policy, and civic tech.

name: State Capacity USCIS Project
details: Looking to fund a budget of ~$2million a year till 2030 primarily to fund salaries for experts. Use state capacity principles to design cross-partisan, pragmatic reforms for the fair, efficient, and timely administration and delivery of immigration services at U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), upholding the law and national security.

name: Toxin Scout Environmental Health Records Lookup
details: Free public tool that makes EPA and government environmental health records easier to search by city, helping residents, journalists, planners, and civic technologists find source-linked data.
